resources.string: Connect an account to save copies of your PDFs and restore them on another device.
Save a document to create your first backup.
Your first backup will appear here after it finishes.
The saved PDFs will be copied to the Scaniqo backups folder in account %1$s. Password-protected PDFs keep their original passwords.
Only saved PDF files are included. Editing projects, tags, the password vault, signature library, and unsaved changes are not backed up.
PDFs will be added as new copies without replacing your current documents. Restoring the same backup again creates duplicates. Protected PDFs still require their original passwords.
Automatic backup will be turned off and Scaniqo’s access removed. Your existing backups will stay in your Google account.
%1$d documents backed up to Google Drive.
Keep this screen open until complete. Leaving it cancels the operation.
Could not authorize Google Drive. Connect again.
Google could not recognize this app version. Update the app or contact support.
Authorize access to Scaniqo files to continue.
Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
Drive did not allow the upload. Check available storage and try again later.
Could not prepare or restore the backup. Check device storage and file integrity.
Could not complete the Google Drive operation. Try again.
The Google account has changed. Connect again before continuing.
Copies are saved in the Scaniqo backups folder in your Google Drive.
Save a copy of your PDFs periodically.
Wait for an unmetered connection to avoid mobile data charges.
Wait until the device is connected to power.
Android chooses when to run based on your frequency, connection, and battery. The exact time may vary.
You can leave this screen. The automatic backup continues in the background.
Automatic backup needs your permission again. Reconnect Google Drive to resume it.
The last automatic attempt did not finish
Refresh the list to see the backups available in this account.
Google Drive has not been enabled for this app. Try again after the service is configured.
Drive access is blocked for this account. Check the account restrictions or contact its administrator.
The current backup or restore will be canceled if you leave this screen.
